Economic Evaluation of Membrane Potential for Ethylene/Ethane Separation in a Retrofitted Hybrid Membrane-Distillation Plant Using Unisim Design. Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Research 52(19), 6524-6539. doi:10.1021/ie400737s

Locators are printed journal page numbers (PDF page = printed - 6523). University of Twente UniSim study of retrofitting an existing ethylene/ethane C2 splitter with a gas-separation membrane (parallel and series). Most results are charts (Figs. 7, 9, 11-13, not loaded). Main file: base C2 splitter (description, molar feed capacity) and the series hybrid retrofit (retrofit capex derived from the printed Table 6 annualized CAPEX and the eq. 8 annualization periods; membrane and equipment lifetimes). Measures: printed savings in % of total annualized cost or condenser cost, ROI conditions, literature claims (reprinted). Other-values: base-case condenser/reboiler duties (GJ/h) and costs, utility prices, annualized capex lines. Traps: no energy saving per t of product is printed (savings are % of cost); capacity is molar (kmol/h) and no mass flow is printed; refrigeration and residual heat, not fuel, are the energy services; costs on the 2010 price level (stated).
